Samir / team —

Below is the technical runbook sketch for the patch. This is a working draft; I'll expand commands into the Jira ticket SUP-3421 and attach the full patch-matrix PDF. High level steps and abort criteria first, then data points to monitor.

Planned approach (ordered):
1) Preflight (T-7 days)
   - Verify pinned artifacts in the private image registry (sha256 hashes) and air-gapped checksum replication to the customer staging registry.
   - Create KV-cache snapshot on each region (s3://greenbank-backups/kv-snapshots/2026-08-xx) — snapshot ensures we can warm caches after rollback.
   - Run low-latency synthetic traffic test against canary nodes (p95 token latency < 120ms).

2) Maintenance window (preferred 02:00-06:00 ET)
   Phase A — Canary (T+0)
     - Pause autoscaler; cordon 10% of serving pods/nodes for canary.
     - Deploy runtime patch to canary nodes with model binary pinned at the patched build and model-serving config referencing previous model version as fallback.
     - KV-cache: allow warm-up for 10 minutes; monitor cache hit-rate and token costs.
     - Metrics to watch (first 15 minutes): p95 latency, error rate (5xx), token throughput, memory pressure, KV-miss rate.
     - Abort if: error rate > 1% sustained for 5 minutes OR p95 increases > 2x baseline.

   Phase B — Ramp (T+30m -> T+120m)
     - If canary stable, increase slice to 33% then 66% then 100% with 15–30 minute observation windows.
     - Coordinate BGP quiesce with GreenBank netops during final ramp to ensure route stabilization (commands will be in SUP-3421).

3) Rollback procedure (one-click path)
   - If abort criteria hit at any ramp stage: immediately re-pin serving config to previous runtime artifact (we maintain a 'pinned' manifest).
   - Trigger KV-cache restore from snapshot for any nodes that lost warm caches.
   - Re-open autoscaler and monitor until steady-state metrics match pre-maintenance baseline.
   - Post-mortem: capture traces and attach to SUP-3421.

Operational notes and dependencies:
- Version pin semantics: we will publish a signed manifest listing runtime binary, libraries, and model hashes. The manifest will be the single source of truth for pin/re-pin operations.
- Networking: we need temporary firewall allowance for the maintenance VLAN to reach the control-plane endpoints for rekey operations. Netops needs change window coordinates 48 hours in advance.
- Timeouts: model KV-cache rebuild can take up to 18 minutes per shard; we account for this in ramp windows.
- Monitoring playbooks: we will hand over runbook snippets for the on-site NOC to trigger rollback (clear checklist: check X, run Y, toggle Z).

Attachments: patch-matrix.pdf (full matrix with per-region timing and shard counts). I'll link the ticket and add commands.

I'll add exact commands and a step-by-step command checklist into SUP-3421 by COB today.

—Karthik
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
